title: Northbeam Promotional Financing: Terms Offered on Each Credit Product
content:
The promotional financing terms of the Northbeam Store Credit and Financing Accounts are set by two figures on each product and, on one product, by a deferred interest basis.

## 1. Smallest purchase that may be put on promotional financing

| Product | Smallest purchase |
|---|---|
| Northbeam Store Card | 299.00 |
| Northbeam Store Card Plus | 299.00 |
| Northbeam Signature Rewards Card | 299.00 |
| Northbeam Deferred Interest Promotion Account | 299.00 |
| Northbeam Business Net Thirty Account | 0.00 |
| Northbeam Business Fleet Line of Credit | 999.00 |

All figures are US dollars.

## 2. Months offered at each purchase amount

The months a promotional plan runs for are what the product's ladder gives for the amount of the purchase. The ladder has three amount bands on every product in the range.

| Purchase amount | Store Card | Store Card Plus | Signature Rewards Card | Deferred Interest Promotion Account | Business Net Thirty Account | Business Fleet Line of Credit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 299.00 to 998.99 | 6 months | 6 months | 12 months | 12 months | 0 months | 0 months |
| 999.00 to 2498.99 | 12 months | 12 months | 18 months | 24 months | 0 months | 6 months |
| 2499.00 and above | 18 months | 24 months | 36 months | 48 months | 0 months | 12 months |

The Northbeam Business Net Thirty Account gives 0 months at every band of its ladder.

## 3. Deferred interest basis

The Northbeam Deferred Interest Promotion Account states a deferred interest basis, which is what becomes of deferred interest where the plan is not cleared in time: the interest accrued from the purchase day becomes payable in full. The other five products in the range state no deferred interest basis; on those it is not applicable.

## 4. Where the bands divide

The bands are stated on both of their sides, so a purchase falls in exactly one of them. A purchase of 998.99 falls in the first band; a purchase of 999.00 falls in the second; a purchase of 2498.99 falls in the second and one of 2499.00 in the third. The figures are the band edges as the ladder states them, not examples.

On a product whose smallest promotional purchase is 299.00, a purchase of 299.00 is large enough to be put on promotional financing and a purchase of 298.99 is not.
